title: S0 invariance and determinism criteria (switch off equals vendor)
serves: M2 -> S1 -> RQ1. Valid pairing for G2 and G3. Kill conditions R1 and R2
source: DESIGN.md 4.3, 6.1, 8 (R1, R2), 10; DECISIONS.md D-006, D-011; TASKS.md M2 exit 2, 3 and M3 exit 6
written: 2026-11-16, before any S0det, S0 or S0v2 run
design_text_verbatim: Precondition: vendor build, same experiment file, same seed, twice. Collected counts and per-minute rows must be equal. Otherwise determinism fails: stop and write a root-cause memo.
Vendor build vs our build with `InformedSearch="0"`: 5 seeds × 3 distributions, F1-a.
Pass: collected count and every per-minute count are equal in all 15 pairs.
Any mismatch: no evaluation run starts. Root-cause memo first.

step_1_determinism.threshold: difference 0 in collected and in every per-minute row
step_1_determinism.contrast: run 1 vs run 2, same build, same experiment file, same seed
step_1_determinism.failure_condition: any difference. Kill R1: stop, root-cause memo, no paired design until fixed. S0 does not start

step_2_invariance.set: S0 (M2), repeated as S0v2 on the M3 build

primary_contrast.pairing: same distribution, same seed, same experiment file except our attributes

step_2_invariance.threshold: 15 of 15 pairs equal in collected and in every per-minute row
step_2_invariance.failure_condition: any pair with any difference. Kill R2: no S3 run until fixed. Root-cause memo first. The memo names the pair and the first differing minute
step_2_invariance.incomplete_run: a run with complete = 0 counts as a mismatch for its pair

noise_basis: The simulator is expected to be deterministic for a fixed seed. Step 1 measures that noise directly. Zero difference is the only threshold that step 1 supports. So no tolerance band exists

reported_not_decisive.layout_sha_equal: per pair, vendor vs cpfa. Reported beside the verdict
reported_not_decisive.vendor_attribute_handling: whether the vendor build accepted our attributes, or ran on a copy of the experiment file without them (DESIGN.md 10)

output.records: this file path and its sha256 (rules/measurement.md 4.1)

seed_rules: Seeds 3001 to 3005 never overlap S1, S2 (1001 to 1030) or S3 to S5 (2001 to 2050). Seeds 0 and 1 are never used (DESIGN.md 6.1)
change_rule: Nothing here changes after the first S0det run. A needed change makes a new file and a new run set
